name: Minimalism
description: Quiet surfaces, one typeface, and almost no decoration.
bestFor: Tools and reading layouts where the content should be the only thing you notice.
promptFragment: Visual style: Minimalism. Use a near-white surface, one sans-serif family, generous whitespace, and a 2px corner radius. Limit the palette to ink, a quiet gray, and one solid button. Avoid gradients, shadows, textures, and extra colors. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
